title: Remarks on Vafa-Witten theory, or how to sit on a wall
summary: We prove three results about refined $SU(N)$ VW invariants on Hirzebruch surfaces. First, we crucially simplify the modular anomaly equation satisfied by the generating series of these invariants by expressing it in terms of complementary generalized error functions, which requires extending these error functions to their singular loci. Second, we evaluate the variation of the modular completions of the generating series upon change of polarization.
